parsedVerdict.reasoning: The domain entity Task does contain legitimate domain behavior: complete() is an immutable state transition and isValid() is an invariant check. It also contains file-based persistence logic. Task.save(storageDir) reads tasks.json with fs, filters the rows, serializes the entity to JSON and writes the file back. Task.findById(storageDir, id) reads and parses tasks.json and rebuilds the entity from raw rows. That is filesystem I/O, serialization and repository-style lookup, which belong in the infrastructure layer, for example in an ITaskRepository implementation. They do not belong in a domain entity. The project already has src/domain/repositories/ITaskRepository.ts and src/infrastructure/repositories/InMemoryTaskRepository.ts, which shows persistence is meant to be handled there.

violations.message: Method save(storageDir) does file-system persistence: it reads and writes tasks.json with fs and serializes to JSON. This responsibility belongs in the infrastructure layer, for example in an ITaskRepository implementation, not in a domain entity.
Static method findById(storageDir, id) does file-system data access and deserialization from tasks.json. This responsibility belongs in an infrastructure repository, not in the domain layer.
